Kindergarten - 5th Grade
Fostering curiosity as your child embarks on a lifelong love of learning.

At Kingdom Heights Preparatory School, our Formation Academy provides a Christ-centered, academically excellent elementary education for K-5th grade students. We partner with families to nurture each child's heart, mind, and spirit, ensuring they are equipped for future success. Our approach goes beyond academics—it's about shaping confident, compassionate leaders who are grounded in biblical truth.

What Sets Formation Academy Apart ?
Choosing the right school for your child is one of the most important decisions you’ll make. At Kingdom Heights, we offer:

items: Christ-Centered Learning: Every subject is taught through the lens of biblical truth.
Academic Excellence: We offer challenging curriculum designed to foster critical thinking and problem-solving.
Character Formation: We cultivate leadership, compassion, and integrity in every student.

Safe & Secure Campus: We have invested in a state-of-the-art security system and we are located in the historic Butler High School, originally built as a military shelter during the Cold War, ensuring unparalleled safety.
Small Class Sizes: We offer personalized attention and a standards-based learning approach to meet the unique needs of every learner.

S.T.E.A.M. & Career Readiness: Preparing Future Leaders

We believe that career readiness starts early . That’s why we integrate STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, Agriculture and Math) education from Kindergarten onward . This hands-on approach encourages creativity, critical thinking, and collaboration , while preparing students for future success.

Our curriculum introduces students to the 16 Career Clusters , helping them explore career paths and discover their God-given gifts. At Kingdom Heights Formation Academy in Huntsville, Alabama , we envision a future where career exploration begins early. Our goal is to introduce elementary students to the 16 career clusters through hands-on activities , STEAM projects , and real-world connections , preparing them for future success while nurturing biblical values .

Fine Arts: Inspiring Creativity

Our state-of-the-art performing arts theatre provides students with opportunities to explore the Fine Arts , enriching their education through creativity and self-expression. Every student has the opportunity to participate in:

Music: Building rhythm, melody, and music appreciation Theater: Encouraging confidence and storytelling Visual Arts: Inspiring creativity through drawing, painting, and design Dance: Promoting coordination and expression Media Arts: Exploring digital creativity and production
Unlock your child’s creative potential .
Latin: Building Strong Thinkers

Starting in 2nd grade , students begin studying Latin , the root of Romance languages and much of the English language . Research shows that students who study Latin score significantly higher on standardized tests , particularly in vocabulary, reading comprehension, and math .

ROYAL HOUR
Character & Leadership Development

At Kingdom Heights, we don’t just educate—we equip future leaders . Our students are encouraged to grow spiritually, academically, and socially. We foster biblical character traits like integrity, humility, resilience, and compassion.

Royal Hour: Each day, students enjoy Royal Hour , a time for tutoring, enrichment, or extracurricular clubs . This encourages them to take ownership of their education , explore their passions, and develop independence.
Empower your child to lead with confidence.
Standards-Based Grading & Limited Homework

Our standards-based grading approach ensures that students master each concept before advancing. If a child needs more time to grasp a skill, they receive targeted support without feeling rushed. Likewise, advanced learners can progress without unnecessary repetition.
We also value family time . That’s why homework is limited , allowing evenings to be spent connecting, resting, and growing together .
Learn how we prioritize both academic success and family balance.
Tuition & Discounts
We offer several tuition discounts to make a Kingdom Heights education more accessible:

items: Multi-Student Discount: $250 off for the second child, $500 for the third, and $1,000 for the fourth or more
Full Payment Discount: 5% off total tuition for families paying in full
Active Military Discount: 10% off for active-duty military families
